market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$104 needs ~+11% to hit $115 (1-min high) by end of June. Already recently spiked to ~$110 on Iran tensions; another bout of escalation in 60 days is plausible. Geopolitical risk premium remains elevated.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether geopolitical premium persists or fades over 8 weeks.
